items.description: Sync baseline to gsd-core v1.17.0: set GSD_CORE_SYNCED_VERSION/COMMIT/TREE_VERSION in src/state_reader/config_json.rs to 1.17.0 / v1.17.0 / 1.17.0; in docs/GSD-CORE-SYNC.md add a v1.17.0 delta section (no config key or default changes; schema/defaults manifests unchanged; capability manifests only changed runtime-only fields), add the templated review.effort.<slug> family (new upstream key review.effort.opencode) to the pass-through table next to review.models.<cli>, bump the re-measure recipe to REF=v1.18.0 / PREV=v1.17.0; update the README.md "synced against gsd-core X" note; DEFAULTS_OPTION_COUNT stays 135; doc/README/constants are tied by tests (the_gsd_core_sync_baseline_is_recorded and sync-record/README tests in detail.rs) so keep them in one commit. Upstream clone at ~/projects/node/gsd-core (tags v1.16.0, v1.17.0).

Emit /gsd-<name> instead of /gsd:<name> (upstream gsd-core e288f4ab2, #4859: colon form is now unregistered): change app-generated colon-form commands in src/state_reader/queue_md.rs fallback suggestions (~314-333) and doc comments (~36-38, ~284-289), backlog enqueue at src/ui/screens/detail.rs ~5621, on-screen hints at detail.rs ~7128 and ~8756-8779; update tests asserting the colon form (detail.rs ~26107-26131, queue_md tests); add a send-time compat rewrite /gsd:<name> -> /gsd-<name> when dispatching to Claude (analogous to codex_command's rewrite for Codex; src/executor/runtime.rs / src/executor/claude.rs) so colon entries already in users' QUEUE.md keep working (INFERRED decision, record it); keep GSD_COMMAND_PREFIXES accepting both forms; do NOT add /gsd-core:gsd-<name> plugin support; also update README/docs/* mentions of the /gsd: form for app-emitted commands.

Fix status misclassification in classify_status (src/app.rs): it matches the word "complete", so a STATE body status like "Phase complete — ready for verification" (written by gsd-core 1.17.0 `phase complete`, upstream fde7d4e80, for the next phase) is likely shown as Complete. First confirm with a failing test; if real, fix so that string classifies as awaiting verification / not complete (closest existing status variant; check upstream status vocabulary in ~/projects/node/gsd-core), plus a test for "Ready to execute". If not a bug, record that and make no code change.
